task: Draft a title, short body, and action labels for a fictional macOS application's upload-error message. Readers need to know whether their notes are safe and how to keep working. Use accessible, nonblaming language and match the documented recovery behavior. Do not imply that a local save is a completed upload or that retry happens automatically.

facts.text: The application could not upload the latest notes because its connection was unavailable.
The notes remain saved on the device.
The latest notes have not been uploaded.
The Retry action lets the user try the upload again after the connection returns.
The Work offline action returns to the editor without deleting the notes.
This implementation does not automatically retry the upload.

forbidden_additions: A claim that the latest notes are already uploaded or have been lost.
Automatic retry or a guaranteed time for the connection to return.
Blaming the reader or requiring deletion or re-entry of the saved notes.
preserve: The distinction between saved-on-device and uploaded.
The option to keep editing offline without losing notes.
